metadata.description: Skills from Codefin - how the company works, written as general standards and packaged so every team and every agent works the same way.

plugins.name: codefin-dev
plugins.description: How Codefin builds software: the three test layers run as gates without being asked, the defect procedure that keeps a fix closed, and the handoffs that keep PO, QA and Dev on one document.

plugins.name: codefin-ba
plugins.description: Business analysis: turning what a customer says into requirements that can be built and acceptance criteria that can be proved, sized honestly, with the scope line held.

plugins.name: codefin-qa
plugins.description: Quality assurance: deriving scenarios from acceptance criteria, keeping coverage honest, running a round, and proving it to the customer at UAT.
